verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's API docs state that you can select scopes when creating an API key to limit its access, which directly supports issuing least-privilege credentials to an agent. OAuth 2.0 authorization-code and implicit flows also let it issue access tokens on behalf of users. Missing for 10: the list and granularity of available scopes, key expiry/rotation and revocation details, agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
